name: io.github.smbcloudXYZ/smbcloud-cli
title: smbCloud Mail & Auth
description: Email infrastructure and authentication for developers: domains, inbox routes, auth apps, deploys.

packageArguments.name: --mcp
packageArguments.description: Run the CLI as an MCP server over stdio instead of executing a one-shot command.

environmentVariables.name: SMB_MAIL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mail app API key (smb_mail_...) used by the mail_send tool. Optional: every other tool uses the session from `smb login`.
